read_first: one exact recruitment/replacement source population or force pool
its capability/population profile when selection quality matters
write_order: prove a lawful source population or existing organized force for every transferred body
settle source state through the transaction time
select only from source strata that actually exist and satisfy the stated criteria
conserve people/horses/equipment/resources and deduct source claims exactly once
carry source occupational/capability/body/age/aptitude/experience/qualification state into the receiving aggregate population
invariants: Strategic manpower pools cannot fight until organized into units.
Returning assigned units preserves losses/history and source lineage.
Player personal units are not auto-created.
Recruitment and replacement are source-to-destination conservation transactions for player, NPC, state, institutional, militia, mercenary, bandit and other forces alike.

A requested source category that has no authoritative population or manpower stratum cannot be fabricated. Recruiting hunters is not equivalent to recruiting agricultural workers unless the source authority explicitly says those populations are the same.
Representation changes storage only: aggregate populations retain the causal profile needed for fair training, selection, aging, casualties, promotion and later named-person materialization.
